correctness.rationale: The curve coefficients lie in C(v⁴,t), with s=v² and Gal(C(v,t)/C(w,t))=C4. Burek Theorem 1.1/Proposition 5.6 establishes generic rank 12; Appendix A.10–A.12 establishes 12 independent specialized sections (height Gram determinant 4096/9). An independently written exact SymPy reconstruction from the source formulas evaluated all 12 section Weierstrass identities at v=5, reconstructed 12x12 H, computed 144 transformed pairwise local/gcd heights for v=5i and the order-two counterpart at v=-5, found T=H^{-1}G with T^4=I, T^TH T=H and traces (12,4,4,4), and verified the independent order-two matrix T². Separate exact arithmetic on the full printed 12x12 integral T confirmed characteristic polynomial (λ−1)^6(λ+1)^2(λ²+1)^2 and invariant dimensions 6 and 8. Injectivity of the twelve-dimensional specialization and ordinary Galois descent, not mere sampling, provide the global rank conclusion. Does not establish integral MW saturation or arithmetic ranks.
